lean4.content_append: Noema portable installation: resolve ../../vendor/lean4-skills/plugins/lean4 from this Skill's directory (the Noema Skill source header). This contains bin/lean4-skills-* wrappers and lib/scripts; invoke wrappers with their resolved absolute paths. References are bundled here in references/. No host-native /lean4:* commands, hooks or subagent definitions are installed. The optional lean-lsp MCP must be explicitly enabled for a prepared Lean project; without it use the documented CLI fallback.
